title: Availability Bias
coreMove: Detect when the availability pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Availability Bias as a specific decision error around availability, letter K, risk map. Traceable support includes Availabil- ity: A heuristic for judging frequency and probability.
